DT_Stack.name: The Stack
DT_Stack.text: Vast designed future city where Baseline Humans, Augments, Organics and Intelligences share one society. The vertical city is literal and symbolic: social class, privilege, access and institutional treatment should be visible in architecture, space, fashion, behavior and art direction without exposition. Every people-type exists at every level of society, but the culture was broadly built around a descending hierarchy of legitimacy and service: Baseline Humans above Augments, Augments above Organics, Organics above Intelligences; each class is generally expected to serve the one above it. Bias is shown through ordinary interaction—who is deferred to, questioned, authorized, trusted, protected, owned, serviced or ignored—not through explanatory dialogue. The boundaries between categories are intentionally unstable. A Baseline with a medical device remains human; an Augment may incorporate mechanical or grown components; an Organic is a grown biological-synthetic person; an Intelligence is manufactured rather than grown but possesses cognition and agency closer to the others than society admits. Each adjacent category is meaningfully different yet not far from the one before it. Division Threshold explores those similarities, differences and the often arbitrary thresholds used to decide what kind of person someone is and what they are owed. Visual inspiration leans strongest toward Altered Carbon, with Snowpiercer and The Hunger Games informing legible class and power. Do not explain this social order in-story; treat it as the ordinary world everyone already inhabits.

DT_OrganicDistricts.name: Organic Districts
DT_OrganicDistricts.text: Neighborhoods where Organics live, work, repair, socialize and build community. They can exist at different economic and social levels. Show lived culture, status, relationships and bias through environment and interaction rather than exposition; do not reduce Organic life to machinery zones or industrial warrens.

DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.name: Governance Upper Levels
DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.text: Controlled civic and corporate upper levels where class privilege and institutional legitimacy are visually legible through space, finish, access, service, surveillance and effortless authority. People from every category may appear here, but they are not treated equally.
